welcome.title: Your journey starts here
welcome.body: Exposure Buddy helps you gradually face the situations and fears you've been avoiding, at your own pace. It's a self-help tool — not a therapy app or a substitute for professional care. Let's start by understanding how things feel for you right now.

resumeFailed.toast: Couldn't restore your progress. Starting from step 1.

assessment.title: What is a fear ladder?
assessment.body1: A fear ladder is a list of situations that make you anxious, arranged from least to most scary. You start at the bottom and work your way up — one step at a time.
assessment.body2: Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) works by helping your nervous system learn that the feared situation is manageable. The anxiety peaks, then drops — every time you face it.
assessment.body3: Courage here doesn't mean feeling no fear. It means taking one small step even when it feels uncomfortable.
assessment.practiceScenario: Imagine you're about to give a short speech to 5 strangers. How anxious would you feel right now?

fearLadder.minimumItems: Add at least 3 situations to continue.
fearLadder.ladderNudge: That's a solid ladder — most people find 10–15 situations gives enough range.
fearLadder.title: Build your Courage Ladder
fearLadder.subtitle: Add the situations that make you anxious, then arrange them from least to most scary.

crisisDetected.banner: It sounds like what you're facing feels very heavy right now. You don't have to manage this alone — tap below to find support.

complete.encouragementSoft: Take your time. Your ladder will be here whenever you're ready.

grounding.breathingPrompt: Take three slow breaths. In through your nose, out through your mouth. Let your body settle.

abandoned.message: Stopping when you need to is an act of self-awareness. You can try again whenever you feel ready.

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.details: Exposure Buddy is the data controller for personal data processed through this app.

dpoSection.title: Data Protection Officer
dpoSection.details: Our DPO can be contacted at:

purposes.title: How We Use Your Data
purposes.details: We process your personal data solely to support your use of Exposure Buddy, a self-help app designed to help you gradually face and overcome your fears. Exposure Buddy is not a therapy app and is not a substitute for professional medical care or any form of therapy. Data processing purposes: account authentication, challenge session support, distress level tracking, courage ladder management, and progress visualisation.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.details: Personal data is retained for the duration of your account. Consent records are retained for the account lifetime plus 2 years after deletion, as required by DPDPA 2023 §8(7). Account deletion enters a 30-day window, after which all personal data is permanently deleted.

rights.title: Your Rights Under DPDPA 2023
rights.details: As a data principal under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, you have the right to: access your personal data (contact the DPO to request an export); correction of inaccurate data; erasure of your personal data (via Settings → Privacy → Delete my account); and to withdraw consent (withdrawal is via full account deletion at MVP).

withdrawal.title: Withdrawing Consent
withdrawal.details: You may withdraw consent by deleting your account from Settings → Privacy → Delete my account. A 30-day window applies before permanent deletion.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Processors
thirdParty.details: Your data is processed by Supabase (database and authentication) and PowerSync (offline sync). No health data, session content, or PII is transmitted to any third-party analytics, advertising, or data-broker service.
